changes: Revert: removed background probe on initial load. Icons and chevrons are now determined on expand (probe-on-expand), same as before 0.5.4. The background probe caused display issues on the main screen.

Fix: export level numbers now appear in the correct tree order. The BFS fetch returned nodes breadth-first (all siblings before any grandchildren), so 4.13.1/4.13.2 etc. rendered after all 4.x rows. Nodes are now reordered to DFS before building the export, so each parent is immediately followed by its descendants.

Fix: Export now fetches the entire BOM tree from Orcanos regardless of what is expanded on screen. Previously only loaded/visible nodes were exported. Now each export format independently BFS-fetches all children (concurrency 6, page size 500) before generating the file.

Fix: Where Used → Locate now highlights correctly when the BOM tree is already expanded. Previously, CHILD_LOAD_OK was a no-op for already-expanded nodes, causing freshly-generated nodeKeys to not match any DOM element. Now Locate reads already-expanded children directly from the live node list (real DOM keys) and only fetches+dispatches for nodes that aren't yet expanded.
Fix: export level numbers now match the screen — root BOM row shows no number; direct children are 1, 2, 3; grandchildren are 1.1, 1.2, etc. Applied to JSON, CSV, and HTML/PDF exports.

Performance: top-level BOMs now render immediately on load, then background-probe each root (concurrency 6) to determine if it has children. Chevrons and Assembly/Part icons update in-place as probes complete — no click required. Probe results land in the existing probeRowsCache so the first expand of any root is instant. Stale probe results (page changed mid-flight) are silently discarded.
Level numbers: each BOM's direct children now restart at 1, 2, 3 (not 1.1, 1.2 chained off the root). Children of children are 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, etc. relative to their own parent.
Level numbers: no longer shown on root (BOM) rows — only children display their hierarchical position (1.1, 1.1.1, etc.).

Export: removed the 'Include Orcanos URL column' option. The Key column is already a hyperlink in HTML/PDF exports; a separate URL column is redundant. JSON and CSV no longer include a URL field either.

Level numbers: every tree row now shows its hierarchical position (1, 1.1, 1.1.1, …) as a dimmed prefix before the chevron. Computed in one O(n) pass over the flat loaded list; stable regardless of expand/collapse state.
⋯ action menu on BOM rows: small dropdown button in the Tree cell (extensible for future actions). Currently contains one item: Export.
Export modal: pick JSON, CSV, HTML (interactive), or PDF; optionally include an Orcanos URL column.
JSON export: recursive tree structure with number, type, fields{}, optional url, and children[].
CSV export: flat table — # (level number), Type, all visible columns, optional URL column.
HTML export: self-contained single file with inline CSS + vanilla JS expand/collapse. Level 1 expanded by default. Key column links to Orcanos.
PDF export: same HTML in print mode (all rows visible) opened in a new tab; browser's print dialog handles PDF conversion.

Fix: Locate highlight now actually persists. The static `.bom-row--located` rule was being overridden by `tr:nth-child(even)` and `tr:hover` (both higher specificity), so the amber background only showed during the 1s intro animation and then vanished. Made the static rule `!important` (same pattern as `.bom-row--errored`).

Where Used → Back now preserves the previous BOMs / Part Catalog state. The main tree stays mounted (just hidden) while Where Used is active, so pagination, search, expanded subtrees and the child cache survive a round-trip and are restored instantly on Back.

Where Used → Locate is now a true level-order BFS: fully expand the current level, scan for the target, stop on first match, otherwise descend. Replaces the previous cheap `CS21 = '<value>'` per-level filter; the level is now visible to the user as it's being walked.

Locate match predicate: descendant.cs21Raw === target OR descendant.cs21Int === target. The `target` is the same value passed to `dbo.fn_GetRootParentByCS21()` (PRT click → itemId, PI click → cs21Raw).
Locate highlight is now persistent: brief amber flash on arrival, then settles to a steady highlight that stays until the next Locate overwrites it or Where Used is exited.
Removed unused `cs21Equals` parameter from `fetchChildren` (was only used by the previous Locate strategy).
Where Used → Locate is now incremental: BFS-expands the BOM level by level and stops the moment the target is found, instead of walking the entire subtree.

At each level the children fetch uses `Filter_By: parent_original_id = X AND CS21 = '<value>'` (the same value passed to fn_GetRootParentByCS21). A non-empty result is the match — no client-side scan needed. If empty, the level is fetched normally so the BFS can recurse into Assembly children.
Added optional `cs21Equals` parameter to `fetchChildren` and a new `findAndExpand(rootNode, { cs21Filter })` method on `useBomChildren`.

Where Used SQL value differs by row type: a Part Instance now passes its **raw CS21 value** to `dbo.fn_GetRootParentByCS21(...)` (instead of the extracted integer). Parts still pass their own id. Added `row.cs21Raw` to the row normalizer for this.

Where Used → Locate matching is now id-based: a descendant matches when its CS21 integer equals the target. Target is computed by row type: for a Part (PRT) it's the part's own id; for a Part Instance (PI) it's the PI's CS21 integer (source PRT's id).
Each row exposes a new `cs21Int` field — first run of digits from CS21 / Master Part Source. Empty for PRTs (no CS21 column).

Where Used → Locate now matches the descendant whose **CS21** (Master Part Source) value equals the where-used item's CS21. That's the canonical 'same part instance' check — replaces the previous Key-similarity heuristic.

Where Used → Locate now matches descendants by **Key** (User_Prefix) similarity rather than originalId. A descendant matches when its Key equals the target Key, or when one is a prefix of the other — covers Orcanos PI-key conventions where a Part Instance's Key is derived from its source PRT's Key.

Where Used: every non-BOM row now has a magnifier icon next to the item icon. Click it to swap the tree to the BOMs that contain that part (filter 609 + `Filter_By: ID IN (select * from dbo.fn_GetRootParentByCS21('<id>'))`).
Where-Used view reuses the main BomTree — pagination, search, expand-all, probe-on-expand, Key→Orcanos hyperlink all work as in the regular view.
Each BOM in the Where-Used result has a Locate (crosshair) button. Click it to expand the BOM and scroll/flash-highlight the descendant matching the original part.
Back banner at the top of the where-used view returns to the previous view. Switching sidebar (BOMs / Part Catalog) also exits Where-Used.
Empty state in Where-Used reads 'This item is not used in any BOM.'
Orcanos record link moved onto the Key column itself — the Key is now a purple hyperlink that opens the matching PRT/PI in Orcanos. Removed the separate 'Orcanos Link' column.
Server-side search: typing in the search box now hits Orcanos with `Filter_By: [Obj_name] LIKE '%query%'` so matches across all pages are returned (BOMs and Part Catalog).
Page size is configurable: edit `<pageSize>` in `public/settings.xml` (default 50, clamped 1..500). Shown in the Settings modal.
BOM name prefixes for the Part Catalog are configurable: `<bomNamePrefixes>50,51,52,53</bomNamePrefixes>` in settings.xml. Items whose Obj_name starts with any prefix render the BOM icon.

Probe-on-expand brought back (only when you click `>`, never on initial page load). Each click fetches the row's children + probes one level deeper so leaves render without a chevron. Probe results cached by `parent_original_id` so the next click on a probed child is instant.
Initial page load and pagination are now single-fetch (no upfront probing) — no multi-second wait when switching pages or views.
Sidebar: Settings and Release Notes moved into a popup menu that opens on the username at the bottom. Main nav now contains only BOMs and Part Catalog.
Popup closes on click-outside or Esc.
Pagination on the BOMs main page — Page_Size 100, First/Prev/Next/Last buttons, status bar shows `BOMs N–M of K · page X/Y`.
API: send `IsNewPaging: 0` + `IsReturnPageCount: "yes"` for the top-level fetch — the only combo that returns rows AND a truthful Total_records (verified via console matrix sweep).
New 'Part Catalog' view in the sidebar — same UI as BOMs, calls filter 611. Reuses BomTree, hook, and probe cache (no duplicate code).
Probe cache: when expanding a row we already fetched the children's children — store them by `parent_original_id` so the next expand is instant. Recursive: works for any depth.
Status bar pinned at the bottom of the view — only the table area scrolls.
Settings: added `partCatalogFilterId` (default 611) to `public/settings.xml` and the read-only Settings modal.
Fix: Refresh and Retry buttons no longer pass the React click event into the request body (was triggering a circular-JSON crash). Added a numeric guard in `loadTop`.
Fix: 'Quantity' restored as a synthetic column after the column-hiding pass in 0.2.0.
API: send IsReturnPageCount=0 — filters 609/610 returned empty Data with 1.
API: children filter now uses `parent_original_id = <id>` (replaced `[Master Part Source] = '<name>'`); IsNewPaging=0.
API: extract `original_id` from a PI's Master Part Source value (e.g. `PRT-39382-901631 ...` → `39382`).
API: row lookup falls back from byName to byTitle and reads value from Display_text/Display/Text/Value (Display_text preferred so picklists like Status render their label, not the internal id).
UX: probe each child for grandchildren on expand — leaves render with no chevron, assemblies keep one. Concurrency cap 6, Page_Size 1.
UX: hide Copy As Link, In Pool, Is Branch, Original ID, ID, Quantity, Master Part Source columns (data still on row, just not rendered).
UX: merge Revision (PRT) and Part Revision (PI) into a single Revision column.
UX: removed cell hover-expand that caused row reflow; native title tooltip replaces it.
Design: new SVG icons — BOM (hierarchy tree, purple), Assembly (gear, orange), Part (hex nut, gray).
Design: added missing --accent-orange (#F5A623) token to design-system.css.
Config: settings.xml filter IDs updated to 609 (BOMs) / 610 (instances).
